name: devbelt-db-client
description: DevBelt — database development inside VS Code. SQL for MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite, plus Redis, Elasticsearch, AI assistance, schema tools, SSH tunnels and end-to-end encrypted sync.

view/item/context.when: view == devbelt.explorer && (viewItem == connectionOpen.ELASTICSEARCH || viewItem == connectionOpen.ELASTICSEARCH.ro || viewItem == esIndexCategory.ELASTICSEARCH || viewItem == esIndexCategory.ELASTICSEARCH.ro)
view == devbelt.explorer && (viewItem == esIndexCategory.ELASTICSEARCH || viewItem == esIndexCategory.ELASTICSEARCH.ro || viewItem == esIndex.ELASTICSEARCH || viewItem == esIndex.ELASTICSEARCH.ro)

devbelt.language.description: Extension language. auto follows VS Code display language.
devbelt.language.markdownDescription: 扩展语言。`auto` 跟随 VS Code 显示语言。

devbelt.format.indent.markdownDescription: SQL 格式化缩进宽度（空格数）。

devbelt.format.keywordCase.markdownDescription: SQL 格式化关键字大小写。

devbelt.ssh.hostKeyPolicy.description: SSH host key policy. tofu: ask and remember unknown host keys; strict: only trust hosts already in known_hosts.
devbelt.ssh.hostKeyPolicy.markdownDescription: SSH 主机密钥策略。`tofu`：未知主机弹指纹确认并记住；`strict`：只信任 `known_hosts` 中已有的主机。密钥变更始终拒绝。

devbelt.export.addUtf8Bom.description: Prefix CSV/TSV exports with a UTF-8 BOM (helps Excel detect encoding).
devbelt.export.addUtf8Bom.markdownDescription: CSV/TSV 导出前置 UTF-8 BOM（便于 Excel 正确识别编码）。

devbelt.sync.autoSync.description: Automatically sync personal connections/groups/queries when unlocked. When off, sync only runs on explicit Sync Now / Pull / Push.
devbelt.sync.autoSync.markdownDescription: 解锁后自动同步个人连接/分组/查询。关闭时仅在手动「立即同步 / 拉取 / 推送」时同步。

devbelt.sync.items.description: Per-machine choice of which entity types sync. Off = not pushed from this machine; incoming changes are parked (not applied) and replayed when re-enabled; local data is kept.
devbelt.sync.items.markdownDescription: 选择性同步（按本机生效，不随同步走）：关闭的类型——本机不推送、云端变更暂存不应用（重新打开后自动补齐，无需重拉）、本地数据保留。关闭「连接与分组」时，「保存的查询」与「表注记」随之停用（它们引用连接）。

queries.description: Sync saved queries and folders (requires connections).
queries.markdownDescription: 同步保存的查询与文件夹（依赖「连接与分组」）。

notes.markdownDescription: 同步表/列注记（依赖「连接与分组」）。

authenticator.description: Sync authenticator entries, groups and tags.
authenticator.markdownDescription: 同步验证器条目/分组/标签。

aiModelAccess.description: Sync AI model access settings (the API key still obeys its own per-item toggle).
aiModelAccess.markdownDescription: 同步 AI 模型接入配置（API Key 仍受其自身「同步 API Key」开关控制）。

devbelt.sql.queryTimeoutSeconds.description: SQL statement execution timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout). Applies to every SQL session; the per-connection request timeout in the connection form overrides it. Changes take effect immediately.
devbelt.sql.queryTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: SQL 语句执行超时（秒，默认 300；0 = 不超时）。作用于所有 SQL 会话；连接表单的「请求超时」可按连接覆盖。改动实时生效，无需重连。

devbelt.diagnostics.enabled.description: Static diagnostics for .sql files (no database access).
devbelt.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: `.sql` 文件静态诊断（不连接数据库）。

devbelt.diagnostics.rules.description: Per-rule severity overrides: off | hint | info | warning | error.
devbelt.diagnostics.rules.markdownDescription: 按规则覆盖级别：`off` / `hint` / `info` / `warning` / `error`。规则：`updateDeleteWithoutWhere`（UPDATE/DELETE 缺少 WHERE）、`dangerousDdl`（DROP/TRUNCATE/ALTER）、`notInSubquery`（NOT IN 子查询的 NULL 陷阱）、`selectStar`（SELECT *）、`dialectMismatch`（与绑定连接方言不符的写法）。

devbelt.dictionary.format.description: Default format offered first when generating a data dictionary.
devbelt.dictionary.format.markdownDescription: 生成数据字典时默认优先的格式（`markdown` / `html`）。

devbelt.insights.historyLimit.description: Number of local query-history entries kept (used by Slow Queries). Oldest entries are dropped first.
devbelt.insights.historyLimit.markdownDescription: 本地查询历史保留条数（慢查询分析使用），默认 100，范围 10–1000。超出时丢弃最旧记录。

devbelt.pg.syncEnabled.description: PostgreSQL cross-schema data + structure sync (syncDatabase). Experimental.
devbelt.pg.syncEnabled.markdownDescription: PostgreSQL 跨 schema 数据+结构同步（syncDatabase）。实验功能。

devbelt.ai.provider.description: AI provider mode. server-proxy: use the DevBelt server (login required). openai-compatible: use your own API key stored in SecretStorage.
devbelt.ai.provider.markdownDescription: AI 接入模式。`server-proxy`：走 DevBelt 服务端（需登录）；`openai-compatible`：自带 Key（存 SecretStorage，不落设置文件）。

devbelt.ai.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1). Used when provider is openai-compatible.
devbelt.ai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: OpenAI 兼容端点根地址（如 `https://api.openai.com/v1`、百炼 `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`）。仅自带 Key 模式使用。

devbelt.ai.includeColumnComments.description: Send column comments as schema context (improves NL2SQL accuracy for Chinese databases; comments are treated as untrusted metadata).
devbelt.ai.includeColumnComments.markdownDescription: 列注释参与 schema 上下文（中文库 NL2SQL 准确率关键；注释按不可信元数据处理）。AI 面板状态条显示发送条数。

devbelt.ai.autoRunReadOnlySql.description: Automatically run read-only SQL blocks in AI Chat replies (SELECT/WITH/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN only; never on production connections; writes and DDL are never auto-run).
devbelt.ai.autoRunReadOnlySql.markdownDescription: AI 对话回复中的只读 SQL 块（仅 SELECT/WITH/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN）自动执行并内联展示结果。生产连接不自动执行；写与 DDL 永不自动执行。关闭后保留手动「Run in chat」按钮。

devbelt.ai.agent.enabled.description: Agent mode in AI Chat: inspect schema, run read-only SQL and EXPLAIN step by step. Never writes.
devbelt.ai.agent.enabled.markdownDescription: AI Chat 的 Agent 模式：查结构、跑只读 SQL 与 EXPLAIN，逐步展示。只读，不写库。

devbelt.ai.agent.maxSteps.description: Maximum model turns per agent task.
devbelt.ai.agent.maxSteps.markdownDescription: 单个 Agent 任务的最大模型轮数（1–50）。

devbelt.ai.agent.maxToolCalls.description: Maximum tool calls per agent task.
devbelt.ai.agent.maxToolCalls.markdownDescription: 单个 Agent 任务的最大工具调用次数（1–100）。

devbelt.ai.agent.timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock limit for one agent task, in seconds.
devbelt.ai.agent.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: 单个 Agent 任务的总时长上限（秒，10–600）。

devbelt.ai.agent.includeSample.description: Send redacted row samples to the model in agent mode (off by default).
devbelt.ai.agent.includeSample.markdownDescription: Agent 模式是否向模型发送脱敏后的行样本（默认关闭）。

devbelt.ai.agent.allowWrites.description: Allow the agent to propose DML. Each statement still needs explicit approval.
devbelt.ai.agent.allowWrites.markdownDescription: 允许 Agent 提出 DML（INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE）。每条语句仍需在弹窗中确认。

devbelt.ai.agent.allowDdl.description: Allow the agent to propose DDL. Each statement still needs explicit approval.
devbelt.ai.agent.allowDdl.markdownDescription: 允许 Agent 提出 DDL（CREATE/ALTER/DROP 等）。每条语句仍需在弹窗中确认。

devbelt.ai.agent.allowProduction.description: Allow agent writes on connections marked production. Off by default.
devbelt.ai.agent.allowProduction.markdownDescription: 允许在标记为生产环境的连接上执行 Agent 写操作（默认拒绝）。

devbelt.mcp.enabled.description: Run a loopback-only MCP server exposing read-only tools for the selected connection.
devbelt.mcp.enabled.markdownDescription: 启动仅监听本机的 MCP Server，为所选连接提供只读工具（默认关闭）。

devbelt.mcp.connectionId.description: Connection exposed over MCP. Empty means no connection.
devbelt.mcp.connectionId.markdownDescription: 通过 MCP 暴露的连接 ID；留空表示不暴露任何连接。

devbelt.mcp.rateLimitPerMinute.markdownDescription: 每个 MCP 客户端每分钟的请求上限。

devbelt.mcp.includeSample.description: Include redacted row samples in MCP read-only query results.
devbelt.mcp.includeSample.markdownDescription: MCP 只读查询结果是否包含脱敏后的行样本（默认关闭）。

devbelt.mcp.maxRows.description: Row limit for MCP read-only queries.
devbelt.mcp.maxRows.markdownDescription: MCP 只读查询的最大返回行数。

devbelt.ai.temperature.markdownDescription: AI 请求采样温度（默认 0.2，SQL 生成偏确定性）。

devbelt.ai.schemaContextMode.description: How much schema context to inject: current-db (default), recent-only (reserved, currently behaves as current-db), off (no schema).
devbelt.ai.schemaContextMode.markdownDescription: schema 注入模式：`current-db` 当前库（默认）；`recent-only` 预留（v1 暂等同 current-db）；`off` 不注入。

devbelt.ai.dataSampleRows.description: Number of sample rows attached to data-QA questions after explicit confirmation.
devbelt.ai.dataSampleRows.markdownDescription: 数据问答在用户单次确认后附加的样本行数（默认 10，上限 50；敏感列打码）。

devbelt.ai.enableInlineCompletion.description: Enable AI inline completion (ghost text) in .sql files. Trigger manually with Alt+/ — it never fires on every keystroke.
devbelt.ai.enableInlineCompletion.markdownDescription: 在 `.sql` 文件中启用 AI 内联补全（Ghost-Text）。用 `Alt+/` 手动触发，**不会**在每次按键时自动请求。

scripts.build: node esbuild.js && cd webview && npx vite build
scripts.test: pnpm -C ../../packages/ai-core build && pnpm -C ../../packages/db-core build && pnpm -C ../../packages/db-host build && pnpm -C ../../packages/explain-core build && cd webview && npx vite build && cd .. && node esbuild.js && vitest run
